subject: Save file format — block layout, checksum, and per-block data structures
overview: GTA:SA save files are stored at Documents\GTA San Andreas User Files\GTASAsf1.b through GTASAsf8.b. Each file is a flat binary with a header block followed by a sequence of tagged data blocks. All values are little-endian. The total file size is approximately 202KB. A simple additive checksum at the end covers the entire file.

file_header.description: The very first 4 bytes of the file are the total size of the first block (block 0, the game header). This double-acts as a rough validation.

block_framing.description: Each block starts with a 4-byte size prefix (the size of the block body, not including the size field itself). Blocks are concatenated end-to-end with no padding.

0.name: Game header / player name
0.description: Player name (24 bytes), save slot number, current mission, timer, city level

1.name: Simple variables
1.description: Game flags: on-foot stats, weapon tier, chaos meter, cash on hand, camera distance

2.name: Garages
2.description: All stored vehicle data (which car is in each garage, damage state, mods)

3.name: Vehicle pool
3.description: Spawned mission vehicles that must persist across load

4.name: Stats
4.description: CStats — 343 int32 entries (see stats_structure.json) in the order they appear in the stats enum

6.name: Player peds
6.description: Full CPed save state for CJ and any co-op companions

7.name: Vehicles
7.description: Extended vehicle pool dump (missions-related spawned vehicles)

8.name: Objects
8.description: World objects that persist after save

10.name: Cranes
10.description: Crane state at each crane site

11.name: Pickups
11.description: All 320 pickup slots (respawn timers, collection state)

12.name: Phone calls
12.description: Phone callback table for mission phone triggers

13.name: Restart points
13.description: Wasted/busted restart points set for the current area

16.name: Gang data
16.description: Gang member counts, turf contested state

19.name: Audio
19.description: Audio script state — scripted sound triggers

20.name: Player info
20.description: Player money, weapon slots, skill levels, outfit, fat/muscle stats

21.name: Stunt jumps
21.description: Which of the 70 unique stunt jumps have been completed

24.name: IPLS
24.description: Active interior ID and loaded IPL flags

checksum.algorithm: Simple additive uint32 sum of all bytes excluding the checksum field itself

player_header_layout.description: Block 0 player header — first 48 bytes of the file (after the 4-byte block size).

fields.name: szPlayerName
fields.description: Null-terminated player name; padded to 24 bytes

fields.name: nCurrentMission
fields.description: Current active main mission ID (0 = no mission)

fields.name: nGameTimer
fields.description: In-game time in milliseconds since new game start

fields.name: bMissionPassed
fields.description: 1 if the current slot has completed the game
